# Daily Transit Brief — 2026-09-29 (Tuesday)

Posted to X as @ungalsoththu. Window: last 24h (Sep 28 ~09:00 → Sep 29 ~09:00 IST).

## Items (5)

1. **[SR] Adambakkam MRTS station shut 7 months after extension opened** — Trains still skip Adabbakam on the Velachery–St Thomas Mount MRTS extension (opened Mar 14); platform–train gap fix awaits redesign + safety clearance. 43 Beach–St Thomas Mount MRTS services operate, six dedicated. — Times of India, Sep 28, 2026. https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/design-flaw-adambakkam-mrts-station-remains-shut-for-seven-months/articleshow/134548727.cms

2. **[TN] Statewide private bus strike, 24h from midnight Sep 29** — Federation of Private Bus Owners' Associations protests the expansion of the women's free-travel scheme to more govt-bus categories from Oct 2. — Times of India (Namakkal), Sep 28, 2026. https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/coimbatore/tn-private-bus-owners-announce-24-hour-strike-to-protest-expansion-of-free-travel-scheme-for-women/articleshow/134541903.cms (Also: The Hindu, Sep 28 — Namakkal association backs strike. https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Coimbatore/namakkal-private-bus-owners-association-extends-support-for-one-day-strike/article71519621.ece)

3. **[SR] 70 of 143 manned level crossings in Chennai Division now electric** — Gate open time cut from ~3 min to 8–12 sec; EOLBs cost ~₹30 lakh each; Beach–Chengalpet section 100% converted (13/13); electrically operated stationary barriers at 133/143. — Economic Times, Sep 28, 2026. https://m.economictimes.com/industry/transportation/railways/70-level-crossings-converted-to-electric-barriers-in-chennai-what-this-means-for-road-users-waiting-at-busy-railway-crossings/amp_articleshow/134545773.cms

4. **[TN] Private omni-bus festive fare surge** — Fares hit ₹4,999 (Kodaikanal), ₹3,199 (Ooty), ₹3,049 (Coimbatore) vs AOBOA caps ₹2,880–2,980; transport dept says it will verify pricing. — Times of India, Sep 28, 2026. https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/chennais-private-bus-fares-hit-5k-ahead-of-festive-rush/articleshow/134548840.cms

5. **[SR] E-bike rental at Chennai Central called costly** — Launched Sep 17, 20 e-bikes, ₹299/3hr(30km) to ₹999/24hr(120km) + ₹3,000 advance, Aadhaar as ID; users compare unfavourably with rentals outside; non-fare-revenue contract. — New Indian Express, Sep 29, 2026. https://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/chennai/2026/Sep/29/enquiries-galore-but-users-claim-railways-new-e-bike-rental-service-at-central-station-a-costly-affair
